title: ebro-mh: a sequential Monte Carlo rule ensemble for binary clinical risk prediction
description:
Implementation of a sequential Monte Carlo rule ensemble for binary clinical risk prediction, together with the comparator models, the calibration and evaluation code, the cohort construction code for three public data sources, the code that runs the geographic external validation, the figure scripts, a synthetic cohort generator, and unit tests.

The repository also archives the recorded outputs behind every reported number: per-participant predictions for each method, seed and fold; the particle traces; the aggregated metrics, paired comparisons, calibration bins and subgroup metrics; and the execution manifests. No restricted data file is redistributed. The synthetic generator reproduces the input format so that the demo and the tests run without any download.
